existing.description: The Commonwealth Scholarship is awarded by the NUS Graduate School to outstanding graduate students from Commonwealth countries for research leading to a higher degree at the National University of Singapore. It is for new, incoming students who are not Singapore citizens or permanent residents and consists of a monthly stipend plus a subsidy for full tuition fees at the University. Stipend rates effective from 1 January 2026 are SGD 3,000 per month for PhD candidates and SGD 2,900 per month for Master's (Research) candidates. PhD scholars who pass the PhD Qualifying Examination may receive an additional stipend of up to SGD 500 per month, and a number of students are selected each semester.
eligibility: Be a citizen of or have been granted refugee status by an eligible Commonwealth country
Be permanently resident in an eligible Commonwealth country
Be available to start academic studies in UK by September 2027
Hold a first degree of at least upper second-class (2:1) honours standard
Be unable to afford to study in UK without this scholarship
existing.eligibility_summary: Commonwealth citizen (low/middle-income country), first degree at least 2:1 honours, permanently resident in eligible Commonwealth country, unable to afford UK study without scholarship
requirements: Proof of citizenship (passport or national ID card)
Full transcripts with certified translations if not in English
References from at least two individuals
documents: Proof of citizenship (passport or national ID card)
Full transcripts with certified translations if not in English
References from at least two individuals
application_method: Must apply through national nominating agency (NOT direct to CSC)
Apply to CSC via CSC Central online application system
Also apply and secure admission for chosen university course
existing.selection_notes: Selection based on academic merit, quality of research proposal, potential impact on development of candidate's home country. The CSC does not accept direct applications for Master's/PhD scholarships.
existing.notes: For 2027/28 cycle: applications open 8 September 2026, CSC deadline 20 October 2026 at 16:00 BST. National nominating agency deadlines may be earlier. Results expected by July 2027. The CSC does not accept direct applications for Master's/PhD scholarships.
existing.application_period: 8 September 2026 to 20 October 2026 (CSC deadline; national agency deadlines may be earlier)
existing.deadline_display: 20 October 2026 at 16:00 BST (CSC deadline for 2027/28 cycle; national nominating agency deadline may be earlier)
